evidence: Official provider contracts plus real-client offline transport and complete application plan/apply coverage. Implemented admission is distinct from live verification.

providers.identity: project, environment, database service, PostgreSQL role and logical database
providers.native: Database View Regenerate changes PostgreSQL password and POSTGRES_PASSWORD; references update at configuration resolution, consumers require redeployment.
providers.recovery: Frozen SQL replacement, fresh authentication, existing issuer alias prerequisite and idempotent POSTGRES_PASSWORD readback. Exact literal/reference consumers are synchronized through shared hosting lifecycle and retain rollout obligations.

providers.identity: cloud project, instance, user and logical database
providers.native: users.update changes an exact user and returns an asynchronous operation; IAM users differ from built-in password users.
providers.recovery: Correlated user-update operation and fresh SQL authentication precede exact frozen consumer synchronization. Existing operation-scoped connector/access acquisition is cleaned up.

providers.identity: AWS account, region, DB instance identifier/ARN, master role and database
providers.native: ModifyDBInstance accepts MasterUserPassword; managed master secrets have separate Secrets Manager rotation semantics.
providers.recovery: Supplied master password or provider-generated RDS-managed secret rotation; generated reset SDK retries disabled and exact secret ARN readback recovers ambiguity. Pending unrelated modifications block ApplyImmediately.

providers.identity: subscription, resource group, full server ARM id, administrator role and database
providers.native: Flexible Server PATCH can change administratorLoginPassword when password authentication is enabled; Microsoft Entra identities are separate.
providers.recovery: Password-only ARM update, native operation completion and fresh SQL authentication precede exact consumer synchronization and required revision activation.
